content:
tvOS 27 is the latest software update for Apple TV 4K, rolling out to all users starting today. Here's a look at the new features in tvOS 27.

tvOS 27 brings a redesigned Apple Podcasts app, new Apple Music features, customizable text sizes, and more.

tvOS 27 can be installed from the Settings app on Apple TV. The update works on all Apple TV 4K models except the first generation, and Apple TV HD is not supported.

Apple's tvOS 27 update includes the following features and changes:

Podcasts: Apple Podcasts on tvOS gets a major revamp, following the design direction of the iOS redesign earlier this year. The new tvOS Podcasts app offers full support for Apple's video features, making it easier to watch video podcasts. The interface also features a fresh new design with sidebar navigation for a smoother experience.

Update via iPhone: tvOS 27 introduces a handy new feature that lets you update your Apple TV 4K software directly from your iPhone. Through the Home app in iOS 27, you can install tvOS 27 and future updates without even turning on your Apple TV.

Apple Music Upgrades: tvOS 27 brings two new features to Apple Music. AutoMix comes to Apple TV, delivering DJ-style transitions between songs — perfect for parties. Support for Hi-Res Lossless audio has also been added, though it requires a compatible external speaker for output.

Larger Text Sizes: You can now adjust the system-wide text size through the Dynamic Type option in the Settings app, making it easier to read from the couch in different viewing environments.

Finally, Apple says tvOS 27 supports faster AirPlay connections, smoother animations, quicker app launch times, and a more responsive Control Center.

Missing Features: Siri AI and Smart Downloads

Notably, tvOS 27 does not include the new Siri AI assistant — only the older version of Siri is available. Reports suggest this is because the upcoming next-generation Apple TV 4K will feature more powerful hardware capable of supporting Siri AI.

Another missing feature is the "Smart Downloads" functionality Apple mentioned at WWDC. Since tvOS has never supported downloading TV content, the announcement came as a surprise. "Smart Downloads" may refer to certain system-related features rather than TV shows or movies. Regardless, this feature is nowhere to be found in the tvOS 27 beta.

Have you installed tvOS 27 yet? How's your experience? Feel free to share with us in the comments.
